ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: PepperedApron uses the camera to add a photo to your recipes or read a printed recipe.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PepperedApron accesses your photos to illustrate your recipes or import a recipe from an image.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: PepperedApron listens to a recipe video you import, on your iPhone, to write down the ingredients and steps that are only said out loud. Nothing is sent.
